title: Visit to Grameen First Foundation
summary: Inaugration of Daan Utsav the Joy of giving & visit to Grameen First Development Foundation a community-focused Indian Non-Profit working for rural development in Mokhada Palghar.
description: Inaugration of Daan Utsav the Joy of giving & visit to Grameen First Development Foundation a community-focused Indian Non-Profit working for rural development in Mokhada Palghar. Founded in early 2021, their primary commitment is to the rural tribal communities of Palghar district with a special focus on Mokhada taluka in Maharashtra, India.Daan Utasav is an initiative by Grammen First Flundation to support the malnourished kids & expectant mothers.
